# Bundled ViGEmBus driver installer

Upstream [ViGEmBus](https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus) is archived and no longer maintained.
This folder keeps a copy of the final public installer so Windows Xbox 360 emulation
keeps working even if the original GitHub project or releases disappear.

## Installer

| File | Version | Source |
|------|---------|--------|
| `ViGEmBus_1.22.0_x64_x86_arm64.exe` | 1.22.0 (“It's dead, Jim”, 2023-11-02) | [nefarius/ViGEmBus v1.22.0](https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus/releases/tag/v1.22.0) |

## Setup

1. Run `ViGEmBus_1.22.0_x64_x86_arm64.exe` as Administrator.
2. Reboot Windows.
3. Start the NSO GameCube Controller Pairing App and use Xbox 360 emulation.
